passages.text: “On that day a fountain will be opened to the house of David and the people of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
passages.sermon:
God will act on that day.
God will open a fountain.
This fountain will be for the house of David.
This fountain will also be for the people of Jerusalem.
The fountain will cleanse them.
It will wash away their sin.
It will remove their impurity.
passages.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְחַטַּ֖את וּלְנִדָּֽה׃

passages.text: And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He is the God who commands all heavenly armies.
He says, “On that day, I will act.”
I will erase the names of the idols from the land.
No one will remember these idols anymore.
I will also remove the prophets from the land.
I will remove the spirit of impurity from the land.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם׀ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־ שְׁמ֤וֹת הָֽעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְגַ֧ם אֶת־ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ ר֥וּחַ הַטֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And if anyone still prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will say to him, ‘You shall not remain alive, because you have spoken falsely in the name of the LORD.’ When he prophesies, his father and mother who bore him will pierce him through.
passages.sermon:
If any person still prophesies, his father and mother will speak to him.
His father and mother gave him birth.
They will say, "You will not live."
They will say this because he spoke lies in the name of the LORD.
When he prophesies, his father and mother will pierce him through.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָיו אָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֤וֹ יֹֽלְדָיו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וּדְקָרֻ֜הוּ אָבִ֧יהוּ וְאִמּ֛וֹ יֹלְדָ֖יו בְּהִנָּבְאֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And on that day every prophet who prophesies will be ashamed of his vision, and he will not put on a hairy cloak in order to deceive.
passages.sermon:
On that day, the LORD of Hosts will act.
Every prophet who prophesies will feel shame.
Each prophet will be ashamed of his vision.
No prophet will wear a hairy cloak.
No prophet will try to deceive by wearing a hairy cloak.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנ֖וֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: He will say, ‘I am not a prophet; I work the land, for I was purchased as a servant in my youth.’
passages.sermon:
A man will speak.
He will say, “I am not a prophet.”
He will say, “I am a man who works the land.”
He will say, “Someone bought me as a servant when I was young.”
passages.original: וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ־ עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃

passages.text: If someone asks him, ‘What are these wounds on your chest ?’ he will answer, ‘These are the wounds I received in the house of my friends.’
passages.sermon: A man will see wounds on his body.\r\nSomeone will ask him, “What are these wounds between your hands?”\r\nThe man will answer, “I received these wounds in the house of my friends.”
passages.original: וְאָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו מָ֧ה הַמַּכּ֛וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑יךָ וְאָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃ס

passages.text: Awake, O sword, against My Shepherd, against the man who is My Companion, declares the LORD of Hosts. Strike the Shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered, and I will turn My hand against the little ones.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts speaks.
He commands the sword to awaken.
He directs the sword against His Shepherd.
The Shepherd is the man who is God's Companion.
The LORD says, "Strike the Shepherd."
When the Shepherd is struck, the sheep will scatter.
The LORD will turn His hand against the little ones.
passages.original: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל־ רֹעִי֙ וְעַל־ גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת־ הָֽרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖י עַל־ הַצֹּעֲרִֽים׃

passages.text: And in all the land, declares the LORD, two-thirds will be cut off and perish, but a third will be left in it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about the whole land.
The LORD says what will happen to the people.
Two-thirds of the people in the land will be cut off.
Two-thirds will die.
One-third of the people will remain alive in the land.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בְכָל־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה פִּֽי־ שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: This third I will bring through the fire; I will refine them like silver and test them like gold. They will call on My name, and I will answer them. I will say, ‘They are My people,’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is our God.’ ”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks about His people.
He will keep one third of the people alive.
He will bring this third group through fire.
He will refine them like people refine silver.
He will test them like people test gold.
This group will call on the LORD’s name.
The LORD will answer them.
The LORD will say, “They are My people.”
They will say, “The LORD is our God.”
passages.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת־ הַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּצְרַפְתִּים֙ כִּצְרֹ֣ף אֶת־ הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְחַנְתִּ֖ים כִּבְחֹ֣ן אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא׀ יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֗י וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣י ה֔וּא וְה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ס
